title: 第15章 开始种植大业第16章 李衍青飞鹏鱼
content_zh:
在阁楼之中，李衍道凝神聚气，以神识轻轻包裹住水衍珠，动作轻柔地抓取数把灵米，继而洒向广阔无垠的海面。
霎时间，只见胧香鱼如闻其召，迅速跃出水面，争先恐后地抢夺这些资源。
视线转向岛上，那些装载着灵米的袋子正以肉眼可见的速度逐渐减少，这一幕让李衍道不由得眉头微蹙，心中升起了一丝忧虑。
随着修为的提升，一阶中期以上的灵鱼已开始需要灵米作为日常的滋养，而在水衍珠中的胧香鱼，因着十倍的时间流速，已有多数突破至一阶中期境界。
如今，灵米的消耗成为了令他头疼不已的问题，显然，胧香鱼对于灵米的需求量远超他的预期。
原本，他想在海水中投入一部分灵石，但在经过一番深思熟虑之后，他放弃了这个念头。
毕竟，保留灵石用于购买更多的灵米，才是当下最为明智的选择。
于是，在接下来的一个月里，李衍道开始了他日复一日的种田修炼。
每日清晨，他都会亲自为那三亩灵田施以云雨术。
待到日落西山，他又会返回水衍珠内，沉浸在对水泽滋生术的深刻领悟之中。
时光荏苒，转瞬即是一个月的光阴。
李衍道将全部心力倾注于水泽滋生术的修炼之上，由最初的略有所得，渐至大成，直至今日，终于达到了圆满之境。
水泽滋生术达到圆满后，他决定着手尝试种植风清草。
考虑到蕴灵阵法隔壁的灵湖底部，能稳定释放三缕纯净的灵气，故而在不增加蕴灵阵法的情况下，他打算填平湖泊，再开垦出三亩新的灵田。
然而，开辟灵田需要大量的灵贝碎，而爷爷所留下的灵石已经所剩无几，这让他不得不重新调整计划。
于是，他打算在现有的五亩灵田旁，开辟一小块试验性的区域，专门用来种植灵药。
由于原本灵田地底每日仅有五缕灵气涌出，为了确保这一小片土地也能获得足够的滋养，他计划在此埋下一枚灵石，试验种植几株风清草。
待到明年灵米丰收之后，他再考虑进行更大规模的种植。
次日破晓，晨曦初露之际，李衍道便已踏上了前往灵田的小径。
远远望去，三姑与大哥已在田间忙碌起来。

李衍道轻声向二人问候，得到了热情的回应后，便开始专注地围绕着他那三亩灵田施展云雨术。
心念一动之间，只见高空中蓦然浮现出一朵洁白无瑕的云朵。
随着他体内灵力缓缓注入，这朵云朵渐渐变得厚重起来。
紧接着，淅淅沥沥的灵雨便开始从云朵中飘落，细密地洒落在种植水灵米的区域，滋润着每一株灵稻。
这些灵雨中蕴含着丰富的精纯灵力，尤其是当李衍道的云雨术达到圆满级别后，灵雨中的灵力更是散发出淡淡的白色霞光。
这朵云的范围恰好能覆盖一整亩灵田。
因此，李衍道只需移动两次，每次保持半个时辰的灵雨浇灌，就能完成三亩灵田的灌溉工作。
content_en:
In the attic, Li Yandao concentrated his energy, gently wrapped the water Yanzhu with his consciousness, grabbed several handfuls of spiritual rice with gentle movements, and then sprinkled it on the vast sea.
In an instant, the sweet fish jumped out of the water quickly upon hearing his call, scrambling to grab these resources.
Turning his gaze to the island, the bags containing spiritual rice were gradually decreasing at a speed visible to the naked eye. This scene made Li Yandao frown slightly, and a trace of worry arose in his heart.
With the improvement of their cultivation level, the spiritual fish above the mid-first level have begun to need spiritual rice for daily nourishment, and most of the obscene fish in the water beads have broken through to the mid-first level due to the ten times the time flow rate.
Nowadays, the consumption of spiritual rice has become a headache for him. Obviously, the demand for spiritual rice by Long Xiangyu far exceeds his expectation.
Originally, he wanted to put some spiritual stones into the sea water, but after some careful consideration, he gave up the idea.
After all, retaining spiritual stones to purchase more spiritual rice is the wisest choice at the moment.
So, in the next month, Li Yandao began his farming practice day after day.
Every morning, he would personally cast cloud and rain spells on the three acres of spiritual land.
When the sun goes down, he will return to the water bead and immerse himself in the profound understanding of the water breeding technique.
Time flies, and a month passes in a blink of an eye.
Li Yandao devoted all his energy to the cultivation of water breeding technique. From the initial modest gains, he gradually developed into a great success. Until today, he finally reached the state of perfection.
After achieving perfection in the water breeding technique, he decided to try planting Fengqing grass.
Considering that the bottom of the spiritual lake next to the Yunling Formation can steadily release three rays of pure spiritual energy, he planned to fill in the lake and open up three acres of new spiritual fields without adding more Yunling Formation.
However, opening up the spiritual field required a large amount of spirit shell fragments, and there were very few spirit stones left by his grandfather, which forced him to readjust his plan.
Therefore, he planned to open up a small experimental area next to the existing five acres of spiritual land specifically for growing elixirs.
Since there were only five rays of spiritual energy flowing out of the Lingtian underground every day, in order to ensure that this small piece of land could receive sufficient nourishment, he planned to bury a spiritual stone here and test plant a few Fengqingcao.
He will consider planting on a larger scale after next year's Lingmi harvest.
At dawn the next day, when the morning light first appeared, Li Yandao had already set foot on the path to the spiritual field.
Looking from a distance, the third aunt and the eldest brother are already busy in the fields.
Li Yandao greeted the two of them softly, and after receiving enthusiastic responses, he began to focus on using the cloud and rain technique around his three acres of spiritual land.
As soon as I thought about it, I saw a flawless white cloud suddenly appearing in the sky.
As the spiritual energy in his body was slowly injected, the cloud gradually became thicker.
Immediately afterwards, the pitter-patter spiritual rain began to fall from the clouds, falling finely on the area where the water spiritual rice was planted, nourishing every spiritual rice plant.
These spiritual rains contain rich pure spiritual power. Especially when Li Yandao's cloud and rain technique reaches the perfect level, the spiritual power in the spiritual rain emits a faint white glow.
The range of this cloud just happens to cover an entire acre of spiritual field.
Therefore, Li Yandao only needed to move twice and maintain the spiritual rain for half an hour each time to complete the irrigation work of three acres of spiritual fields.
